errors.text_span: 类别的具体名称未提供
errors.evidence: The description claims the category names on the x-axis are not provided, but they are clearly visible and readable in the image (e.g., 空间实体, 事件, 处所).

errors.text_span: 纵轴表示百分比，范围从0%到100%，以20%的间隔均匀刻度。数值刻度间隔为20%
errors.evidence: The figure does not have a visible y-axis with a labeled scale, range, or tick marks. The description invents these details.

errors.text_span: 验证集和测试集的比例为17%
errors.evidence: For the category '处所', the description states the validation set is 17%. The chart clearly shows its value is 19.1%. This is a significant numerical error.

errors.text_span: 未按特定规则排序（如降序或字母顺序）
errors.evidence: The chart categories on the x-axis are sorted in descending order based on the percentage values of the '训练集' (training set, blue bars).

The description claims that for 'other categories', most values are below 5%. However, the category '方向' has values of 8.7%, 8.8%, and 10.0%, all of which are significantly above 5%. The category '终点' also has a value of 5.1%. This makes the statement factually incorrect.

errors.text_span: 训练集、验证集和测试集的比例均为31%
errors.evidence: For the '空间实体' category, the values are 31.6%, 31.3%, and 31.6%. Rounding them all to 31% is an oversimplification that loses precision.

errors.text_span: 事件类别中，训练集和测试集的比例为22%，验证集的比例为21%
errors.evidence: The actual values for the '事件' category are 22.1% (training), 21.8% (validation), and 21.7% (test). The description incorrectly rounds 21.8% down to 21% and 21.7% up to 22%.

errors.text_span: 各数据集的分布比例非常接近
errors.evidence: The phrase '非常接近' (very close) is subjective and interpretive, which the prompt instructs to avoid.

errors.text_span: 显示出类别分布的不均衡性
errors.evidence: The phrase '不均衡性' (imbalance) is an interpretation of the data, not a direct description of the visual elements.
